title: ホテル事業と父の志「日本再興」継承し飛躍させる　アパグループ社長兼CEOの元谷一志氏
extracted_text: 日本最大のホテルネットワークを一代で築き上げる一方、保守言論人としても活躍したアパグループ創業者の元谷外志雄会長が2月に亡くなった。現在、同グループを率いるのは会長の長男で、令和4年に社長兼最高経営責任者（CEO）に就任した元谷一志氏だ。国家観や歴史観が近かった安倍晋三元首相と深い信頼関係で結ばれ、「誇れる国・日本を再興したい」と活動してきた父の志を「継承、変革、飛躍させる」思いを聞いた。（編集長　矢野将史）
translated_text: APA Group founder and Chairman Motoya Hideo, who built Japan's largest hotel network in a single generation while also serving as a conservative commentator, passed away in February. Currently leading the group is the chairman's eldest son, Motoya Hajime, who became President and CEO in 2022. Bound in deep trust with former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe, who shared similar national and historical views, we heard his desire to 'inherit, transform, and soar' his father's vision of wanting to revitalize Japan as a nation we can be proud of. (Editor-in-Chief: Yano Masashi)
title_en: Hotel Business and Father's Vision for 'Japan's Revitalization': Inheriting and Soaring - Motoya Hajime, President and CEO of APA Group
